cohort_preservation.only_fetch_manifest_change: actor feature adds armillary/tokio and tokio/macros using already selected packages.

behavior_preservation.normalization: UTF-8 decode and CRLF to LF from the unchanged // A write is only ever asked marker to EOF. Public request/update DTO segment independently compared byte-for-byte after newline normalization.
behavior_preservation.legacy_constructor_signatures: spawn_fetcher, spawn_fetcher_with and spawn_fetcher_with_policy retain ActorHandle<FetchCommand> plus Receiver<FetchUpdate>.
behavior_preservation.legacy_boundary: Original Armillary mailbox remains unbounded; active/pending execution is bounded after dequeue and explicit ActorHandle.join waits for tracked task cleanup. This does not claim bounded legacy ingress or completion from nonblocking Drop.
behavior_preservation.bounded_companion: spawn_fetcher_with_admission returns FetchActor; reserve active/pending capacity before enqueue, direct exact-ID CancelPage control, explicit close_and_join report.
behavior_preservation.browser_correlation: Distinct request IDs remain separate even at one URL. Same-ID intent supersedes the previous generation, including if latest intent is refused for overload; first terminal outcome per generation wins. Preexisting progress already being emitted may arrive late; host request-correlation remains authoritative.
behavior_preservation.writes: Explicit Submit only; no introduced retry/dedup/redirect following. Started interrupted writes without an observed receipt report delivery unknown, not retried; unstarted queued writes report not sent.

admission.queue_clock: At reservation, including mailbox time; expiry checked before and after active permit acquisition.
admission.native_clock: Existing ClientFetchPolicy whole-operation timeout begins after queue admission; native protocol/redirect/body policies remain unchanged.
admission.capacity_scope: Operation/payload ownership counts, not aggregate body/output memory or HTTP pool connections.
admission.permit_release: Job slot is its last field, after transport future/completion cleanup; no reservation released at terminal-notification time alone.
admission.shutdown: Fence bounded ingress, signal stop, drop mailbox-resident jobs, ResidentTasks.close_and_join all admitted futures, then ActorHandle.join worker. Synchronous future work remains cooperative.
admission.report: TaskReport is actual joined completed/cancelled/panicked/rejected work; admitted counts capacity reservations, discarded_before_spawn accounts jobs whose payloads are destroyed before future creation, overloaded and queue_timeouts remain distinct.

gates.warnings_boundary: 31 unchanged dependency compiler diagnostics plus inherited unused-patch notices in default graph; owned fetch all-target Clippy passes -D warnings.

evidence_scope: Rust supplier/native localhost HTTP, Gopher and Spartan fixtures; no application receiving, headed, physical radio, independent-machine or whole-workspace qualification.

consumer_lane.next: Adopt bounded FetchActor handle in Turnstone and qualify browser/session receiving separately. Other original API callers retain source compatibility.

workspace.reason: Concurrent Canvas and custody edits/commits in shared primary during implementation; pinned clean committed source for final gates.
workspace.cleanup: Remove clean temporary worktree after verified push/integration. Preserve unrelated worktrees and primary changes.

review: Two bounded Luna lanes reviewed Armillary reuse and consumer compatibility; independent static review accepted corrected per-ID publication, permit lifetime, truthful submission and shutdown ordering. Root ran Cargo gates.

receipt_budget.retention: Compact command/attempt results and source/binary identities only; no copied executables or full build logs.

hash_convention: Git tree/blob identities are committed normalized inputs. native_sha256/artifact SHA256 hash exact filesystem bytes. Receipt JSON is UTF-8 LF and protected by -text attributes.
